questions.text: Should M2-004 use a single sooperlooper_engine_launcher class that owns the orchestration, or a thinner coordinator pattern? Consider: testability, lifecycle ownership, generation sync, and future M2-005 (JACK routing) integration.
How should deterministic OSC port and JACK client names be derived from instance identity + generation? Consider: avoiding conflicts, readability, and reset behavior on restart.
